KristinTaylor12 days ago(+4)

SPOILERS!






Simplified starter walkthrough:
SW, take Brush, return to start, NW, take Shovel, NE, 3-10-9-12-6-5 o'clock, NE, open fridge, give Brush, take Wet Brush, NE, check fin-on-wall, return to start, SE, check eyes, SE, give Shovel, take Worm, take Bucket, open chest, take Zipper, return to start, NE, set eyes, check warts, NE, raise line, give Worm, lower line, wait, raise line, take Fish ...

From here, things can diverge depending on where you choose to put the bucket (sculpter or well), and which three-eyed monster you use the key (from the well) on.
